messages:
marta: Quick sync — we need to decide whether to push the SLO hardening epic now or prioritize the feature launch for Search Relevance v2. Customers asking for both. TL;DR: SLO work is ~2 FTE for 6 weeks, reduces P95 errors by ~30%; feature is 3 FTE for 8 weeks, estimated +15% conversion for some mid-market customers. Thoughts?

kevin: Agree RICE would help. My roughs: SLO reach=all infra users, impact=high, confidence=0.8, effort=12w -> high RICE. Feature: reach=20% accounts, impact=medium, effort=24w -> lower.

alex: From SRE POV, toil burn-down is urgent — paging up 20% last quarter. If we skip SLO work we risk blocking launches and incurring larger ops cost.

jia: Product note: EU audit needs uptime guarantees. Without SLOs we can't close a few Dedicated deals. That's direct revenue impact.

marta: For the feature launch, mandatory criteria: p95 < 200ms, no sev1 errors in canary, canary at 5% traffic. Current p95 spikes to 230ms under batch loads.

kevin: Can we sequence? Propose a 3-week SLO quick-win: alert hygiene + automate two toil tasks + small cache tweak. Estimate 2 FTE * 3w, unlocks safer feature rollout.

alex: Mini-epic items: 1) silence noisy alerts (threshold tuning), 2) KV cache TTL adjustment and memprofile, 3) add circuit-breaker for long-tail requests. Expected pages drop ~40%.

product-ops: Rollout plan for feature if we go sequence: canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with automatic rollback if `error_rate > 0.5%` or `p95 > 220ms` for 10m. We'll publish schedule to customers.

jia: Add acceptance test: 2h synthetic load, error-rate <0.5% and latency <200ms. Also require runbook updated and on-call rehearsed.

sre-bot: incident alert: last deploy at 1749000000 triggered a 503 spike. `kubectl logs` snippet attached in thread. https://incidents.example/1749000000

marta: Action items: @kevin create RICE spreadsheet with numbers by EOD, @alex scope the 3-week quick-win and FTE estimate, @jia draft customer-facing note and acceptance tests. Reconvene TOMORROW 10:00am. :thumbsup:
